turns.question: In sessions between 20 September and 3 October 2026 that had both an add-to-cart and a checkout, what was the median number of minutes from the first add-to-cart to the checkout?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the median minutes from first add-to-cart to checkout, so I cannot give that figure. The closest metrics are Cart-to-checkout rate (a share of add-to-cart sessions that checked out on the same or next day, not minutes), Cart sessions and Checkout sessions (daily counts).
